summary: CDT Equity Inc. filed an 8-K to report modifications to existing financing agreements: a second amendment to a directed stock purchase agreement (equity line of credit) and an amendment to a senior secured convertible promissory note. The amendments set a $510,000 gross purchase price per closing, extend the adjustment period, and redirect 10% of ELOC proceeds to note payments, effective through May 31, 2026. This is a routine amendment of financing terms, not a special situation like an acquisition, restructuring, or capital return.
